# Theming decisions

The log of the product owner's design decisions. Each entry of the first table is a
decision, never a proposal. What an agent proposes stays in its report until the owner
approves it here. A decision in this log stays decided: later rounds, ported fixes and
agents do not undo it. When something collides with one, ask, with the options.

| Date | Topic | Decision | Visible change | Who |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-19 | The design | **The app is redesigned first, to the mockups of the design canvas (`design/redesign/`, 47 screens), and the theme is applied to that design**, not to the app as it was. The owner asked for the redesign ("manage orders first, then the other options") and then for the conversion on top of it | Every screen changes: see `design/redesign/SPECS.md` | Luis |
| 2026-11-19 | Tablet | **Tablet compatibility is in scope** ("if it is not there, include tablet compatibility"): the schema has a `tablet` platform beside `phone`, and the app lays out for tablets | Tablets get their own layout | Luis |

## Taken from the driver app's log, not asked again (to confirm)

The owner took these for `ordering-app-driver-theming` between 2026-11-13 and
2026-11-19 (its `docs/theme/decisions.md`). The business app is the same family of
products and the redesign's canvas was drawn with the same kit, so the coordinator
applies them here **as working assumptions**. They are not the owner's decisions for
this app until confirmed; any of them can be reopened.

| Topic | Assumption |
|---|---|
| Product type | `store_app` (api-core's `BuilderProductTypeEnum::STORE_APP`) |
| Repository | This repository (`ordering-app-business-theming`), split from `ordering-app-business-v26`; the conversion arrives by pull request from `feature/theming-native` |
| Look of the defaults | The build's defaults reproduce the mockups: the driver app's roles, colors and scales (primary `#1E72E3`, Poppins, flat surfaces drawn with lines, corners 8 / 10 / 15, header 56, controls 44 / 50) |
| One design | No legacy layout and no layout option in the schema; a piece of the old design that must come back is a variant of one component |
| Behaviour | Every rule of behaviour of today's screens (status, server config, feature flag, user level) is kept unless the mockups change it |
| Fonts | The catalog's 10 families, static, weights 400 / 500 / 600 / 700 bundled |
| Dark mode | Out of scope |
| Areas left out | What the map library paints, WebViews, system dialogs, the printed ticket's content |
| Libraries that paint their own UI | Replaced by the app's primitives (ported from the driver app); every select opens as a bottom sheet |
| Dangerous actions | Guarded by a confirmation or a press-and-hold; **accepting an order is always one direct tap** |
| Icon sets | Ionicons and MaterialCommunityIcons only |
| Package manager and versions | pnpm 12, Node 22.13 or later, the sister apps' pins |
| Publishing | Production only, through the GitHub Actions workflow, never by hand; the schema is published once, as `1.0.0`, when the final pull request merges |
| Deliverables | `docs/theme/` |

## The coordinator's calls (not the owner's decisions; for the owner to review)

On the owner's instruction of 2026-11-19 ("take the recommended ones and review
later"), the questions of [open-questions.md](open-questions.md) are settled as
follows. They are the coordinator's calls: any of them changes on the owner's word.

**Rule: every question `OQ-01`…`OQ-28`, `TQ-01`…`TQ-11` and `T1`…`T9` takes its
option (a), the recommended one, as written in that file — except the rows below,
where one of the owner's decisions above says otherwise.**

| Question | Call | Why it is not plain (a) |
|---|---|---|
| OQ-07 Tablet: details and history | **(b)**: the board with a right-hand detail panel (sheets become centred dialogs); History is a screen opened from the board's header | The owner chose "the board by columns with the order's details as a panel" |
| OQ-08 Tablet: how it is decided, rotation, panes | A tablet is decided by the device (`usePlatform()`), **tablets rotate freely, and Messages, Stores and Printers get two panes in landscape**; phones are locked to portrait (the recommended part of (a), a visible change: phones rotate today) | The owner chose two panes and free rotation for tablets |
| OQ-09 The Messages list | (a) without the preview line: **no last-message line until api-core gives it** (a request is listed); the title is the customer, unread = `unread_direct_count` | The owner chose "not drawn yet" for data the API does not give |
